body:
# Market brief — Monday 2026-11-09 7:30 ET

## Calendar — next 5 market days (chronological)

**Mon 2026-11-09**
- no major prints (Fed speakers: Bowman 8:40 ET, Goolsbee 10:00, Barkin 12:15; 3-year note auction 13:00)

**Tue 2026-11-10**
- 08:30 ET — CPI and Core CPI (October) — key inflation for Fed path

**Wed 2026-11-11**
- Veterans Day: equities open regular hours; US bond market closed (SIFMA recommendation)
- no major prints

**Thu 2026-11-12**
- 08:30 ET — Initial jobless claims — labor market read

**Fri 2026-11-13**
- 08:30 ET — PPI and Core PPI (October) — producer prices

(Monthly options expiration Friday Nov 20, outside window. No FOMC this week; next Dec 8-9. Recent NFP Nov 6: +165k vs prior +60k, UR 4.1% vs 4.2%.)

## Stock / catalysts — next 30 days

**2026-11-09** — ASTS — Third quarter 2026 business update conference call 5:00 PM ET — confirmed — company IR / press

**2026-11-12** — TMC — Third quarter 2026 corporate update conference call 4:30 PM ET — confirmed — company PR

**Q4 2026 (NET ~Dec 30 placeholder)** — ASTS — BlueBirds 14, 15 and 16 launch (satellites arrived Cape Canaveral in October; Falcon 9 listed by trackers, not confirmed by AST) — window — company updates, launch trackers

**late 2028** — ASTS — Blacklift reusable rocket first flights (announced 6 Nov 2026; up to 5 BlueBirds per launch; Firefly engines) — window — company announcement

ASTS: no other single-day dated operational events in 30d beyond the call; constellation target ~45 by early 2027 slipped from end-2026.

TMC: no dated operational (collection tests, vessel, ISA/NOAA process, offtake, Korea Zinc) in next 30d; NOAA certification was guided for October 2026 (status unclear; process expected to conclude by end Q1 2027 per earlier company statements). No warrant expiration dated in window.

No published geo meetings with agenda linking to critical minerals, spectrum, or deep-sea in 30d.

## Insiders — recently reported (ASTS, TMC)

Lookback ~14 calendar days of reported filings (filing date):

**ASTS**
- Maya Bernal (Chief Accounting Officer): tax withhold (F) 3,935 shares at $40.66 (~$160k) on 17 Oct 2026 (filed ~19 Oct); remaining direct holding ~128,514. Routine vesting withhold.

No open-market purchases or sales reported in last 14d. (Prior: Yao 10b5-1 sale 40k @ ~$59 on 16 Sep; Gupta sale 12k same day; Cisneros open-market buys ~$619k on 31 Aug.)

ASTS: no open-market Form 4/144 in last 14d.

**TMC**
- Liam M. Mallon (Director): RSU grants 77,720 on 28 Sep and 25,445 on 25 Sep (filed 9 Oct).
- Andrew Hall (Director): grant 72,935 on 11 Sep (filed 16 Sep).

No open-market activity in last 14d. (Prior large Allseas 10% purchase July outside window.)

TMC: no open-market Form 4/144 in last 14d.

## Rates and bonds

10y yield ~4.85–4.86% (recent closes ~4.86% on 6 Nov; slight daily moves). 1-week change modestly lower from ~4.9x.

2y yield ~4.51%. 10y–2y spread +0.35 percentage points (not inverted).

5y TIPS real yield ~2.35%; 5y nominal ~4.64%; 5y breakeven ~2.3%. 10y breakeven around similar. 5y5y forward inflation unavailable in sources checked; use 5y/10y breakevens ~2.3%.

One sentence: Recent strong NFP (+165k) and sticky inflation keep Fed on hold near 4% with markets pricing possible further hike in December; real yields remain restrictive.

## USD/JPY

Spot ~157.9–158.0 (overnight ~-0.3%). Rangebound in recent weeks near 157.5–158.5. No fresh intervention chatter or major BoJ shift noted; tracks US yields.

## Equities tape

SPX last close 7,376.86 (+0.31% Friday); ~6% below recent resistance/peak area near 7,840. Overnight ES futures ~7,448 (+0.6%).

QQQ ~656 (+1.4% Fri); NDX similarly. IWM ~274 (+1%).

Breadth: advancing issues ~53.5% on Friday. Specific % above 50d/200d or NH/NL not immediately available; equal-weight proxies mixed after recent volatility. VIX ~25.6, elevated post recent selloff (down from higher spikes).

## Names / themes only if material overnight

ASTS closed Friday +7% at $32.33 after volatile week (down sharply YTD); premarket near flat. Earnings call today AMC is the near-term catalyst (launch cadence, revenue, government contracts). Blacklift rocket announcement (Nov 6) is recent but longer-term (2028).

TMC: no material overnight headline or move flagged. Call Thursday.

No other critical minerals or space/spectrum dated items overnight.

## What actually matters this morning

- ASTS Q3 update after the close today: any update on BlueBird 14-16 launch timing or intermittent coverage targets can move the name and space-to-device theme.
- Tuesday 08:30 ET CPI: primary driver for rates, USD/JPY, and index volatility this week.
- Elevated VIX (~25) after last week's tech/AI selloff; futures rebound overnight but vol regime remains higher.
- TMC regulatory and operational update on Thursday call: any NOAA progress or collection-system timing.
- Bond market closed Wednesday for Veterans Day (equities open); thin fixed-income liquidity midweek.

Sources: company IR/PR, BLS/Fed calendars, SIFMA, SEC Form 4 aggregators, Treasury data, futures quotes. No investment advice.
